versions.content: Purpose of DocumentElementScope The DocumentEle- mentScope specifies if an element in an AUTOSAR or custom specification is relevant for this DataExchangePoint . Elements of Autosar Specifications are identified by their Id (e.g. TPS_STDT_00187) that is composed according to [TPS_STDT_00042] or its name if the specification element is a SPEM Work Definition or SPEM Work Product in the Methodology specification [18]. Custom elements are referenced by DocumentElementScope . customDocumentElement .
